metadata.description: An explicit edge to dbx-web:build-base, NOT `^build`. This rollup entry point writes into dist/packages/dbx-web/eslint, a subdirectory of a dist that @nx/angular:package deletes wholesale (deleteDestPath) at the start of dbx-web:build-base -- so the edge is real. But it has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to dbx-web:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory.  This is the only dbx-web entry point with a build target of its own: the ng-packagr secondaries (table, docs, calendar, mapbox, style-demo) are discovered and built by dbx-web:build-base itself.
